ns2:group.ns2:title: He designs Dia. He uses Raycast to control it.
ns2:group.ns2:description:
Charlie Deets is a product designer at The Browser Company, where he works on Dia. Before that he spent five years designing at Apple, on Safari among other things, and was the fourth designer at WhatsApp. Since going full Raycast, he runs his Mac with no dock and no menu bar: Raycast is how he talks to the OS.
In this What's in my Raycast, Charlie shows Pedro how he keeps himself in flow. Window management on hyper-key quadrants, notes and dictation a keystroke away, switching Dia tabs through Raycast instead of the browser's own UI, and the menu bar replaced by commands. Then his design toolkit: SF Symbols, favicons, color picking, fonts, logos and special characters, all without leaving the app he's in. He finishes with clipboard history, Raycast on Windows for gaming, and the personal to-do app he built as an extension.

ns0:entry.ns0:title: [Raycast]The New Standard Paris: Raycast, Linear and Mistral on building software with agents

ns2:group.ns2:title: The New Standard Paris: Raycast, Linear and Mistral on building software with agents
ns2:group.ns2:description:
The New Standard came to Paris. Thomas (co-founder and CEO of Raycast), Tuomas (co-founder and CTO of Linear) and Théo (VP of Engineering at Mistral) talk with Tanguy, Raycast's very first angel investor, about how software gets built now that agents write so much of the code: shipping without human review, what stays off-limits to agents, building for agents, craft and quality, team shape and hiring, and what they'd do differently. Then an open Q&A with the audience.
The New Standard is our event series on how tech, product and design are changing, after San Francisco, New York and London. Thanks to Linear for co-hosting, and to everyone who came.

ns2:group.ns2:description:

Open Raycast, search for Send Feedback, pick a category, describe what happened, attach files like PDFs or screenshots, and include your Raycast logs. ns0:entry.ns0:title: [Raycast]New in Raycast AI: Automations, Projects and a new Harness

ns2:group.ns2:title: New in Raycast AI: Automations, Projects and a new Harness
ns2:group.ns2:description:
Raycast AI is a proper agent now. The AI harness was rebuilt from the ground up, and it powers a lot of new stuff: Automations that run prompts on a schedule, Projects with shared memory and a working directory, and an AI Chat that plans, uses your extensions, loads skills, writes and runs code, checks the results, and keeps going until the task is done. If something fails, it tries a different approach, and it stops to ask you when it needs to. You can also connect your ChatGPT or Claude subscription and keep using the Raycast interface on top of it.
Download Raycast → http://www.raycast.com/ Thomas on the new usage-based pricing → https://youtu.be/FEgUktmN3gs Check out the Raycast Manual → https://manual.raycast.com/ Sign up for a free trial → http://www.raycast.com/pro
